deficiency.title: Free of accident hazards / supervision / devices
Food procurement, storage, preparation and service

evidence.snippet: Based on observation, interview, and record review, the facility failed to ensure the environment remained free from an identified transfer hazard for one of five residents reviewed for accidents.
Observation showed the transfer sling available in Resident #12's room did not match the size documented in the current care plan.
The Director of Nursing stated that staff should verify sling size before each mechanical-lift transfer and acknowledged that the verification was not documented.
The facility failed to maintain hand hygiene practices during medication administration for two observed staff members.
Glove changes were observed without documented hand hygiene between resident contacts.
The infection preventionist confirmed that competency observations had not been completed for the current quarter.

pocSection.title: Affected residents
pocSection.content: Resident #12 was assessed immediately for injury, and the transfer sling was replaced with the size specified in the current care plan. The responsible nurse documented the assessment and notified the resident representative on August 15, 2026.

pocSection.title: Other residents at risk
pocSection.content: [Information needed: Identify the residents who use mechanical lifts and record the date their sling-size and care-plan review was completed.]

pocSection.title: Corrective measures
pocSection.content: The Director of Nursing will re-educate licensed nurses and nursing assistants on matching sling size to the care plan and verifying equipment before every mechanical-lift transfer. Competency will be observed before staff resume independent lift transfers.

pocSection.title: Monitoring
pocSection.content: The unit manager will audit five mechanical-lift transfers weekly for four weeks, then monthly for two months. Results will be reviewed by the Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement committee, with immediate correction of any variance.
